Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Admitting honestly that you never expected things to turn out this way.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 说实话，我一开始也没想到事情会变成这样。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Saying that if you had been told in advance, you would certainly have arranged things properly.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 要是当时你提前告诉我，我肯定会安排好的。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Saying the job is stressful yet still gives you a strong sense of achievement.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 虽然这份工作压力不小，但我还是很有成就感。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Suggesting that instead of complaining, it is better to think about how to solve the problem.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 我觉得与其一直抱怨，不如想想怎么解决。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Explaining that although he speaks bluntly, he is actually very kind-hearted.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 他这个人说话直接，其实心肠特别好。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Commenting that prices have risen sharply and living costs are much higher than before.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 最近物价涨得厉害，生活成本比以前高多了。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Saying you will try your best to get there, but traffic conditions are unpredictable.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 我尽量赶过去，不过路上情况实在说不准。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Pointing out that the task sounds simple but is actually troublesome to carry out.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 这件事听起来简单，真正做起来却很麻烦。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Proposing to look at the issue from another angle in the hope of finding a new solution.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 我们不妨换个角度想想，也许会有新的办法。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Realizing after a long discussion that you both actually mean the same thing.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 说了半天，其实我们的意思是一样的。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Saying that once you get used to the pace here, life feels much easier.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 习惯了这里的节奏以后，你就会觉得轻松多了。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Explaining that you meant to leave earlier but were held up by something unexpected.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 我本来想早点走，结果被临时的事情耽误了。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Comforting someone by saying not to dwell on small things since tomorrow is a new day.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 这种小事就别放在心上了，明天又是新的一天。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Saying that if circumstances allow, you would rather work remotely from home.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 如果条件允许的话，我更愿意在家远程办公。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Praising someone's very standard Mandarin with almost no detectable accent.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 他的普通话说得非常标准，几乎听不出口音。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Observing that the more anxious you are, the more likely you are to mess things up.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 越是着急的时候，越容易把事情办砸。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Saying you have long wanted to learn an instrument but can never find the time.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 我一直想学一门乐器，可惜总是抽不出时间。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Noting that despite his young age, he handles problems quite maturely.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 别看他年纪不大，处理问题倒是相当成熟。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Saying the restaurant has good service and reasonably fair prices.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 这家餐厅的服务态度好，价格也算合理。

Daily Conversation|Advanced.meaning: Concluding that since everyone agrees, you will go ahead with this plan.
Daily Conversation|Advanced.sentence: 既然大家都同意了，那我们就照这个方案做吧。

Daily Conversation|Beginner.meaning: A cheerful morning greeting that also comments on the nice weather.
A simple way to say hello and introduce yourself by name.
A polite reply when someone asks how you are doing.
Asking politely for a cup of hot water.
Apologizing for arriving late.
Asking how much something costs while shopping.
Suggesting that you eat lunch together.
Asking someone whether they are busy today.
Saying that you do not really like drinking coffee.
Saying goodbye until tomorrow and telling someone to be careful on the way.
Politely asking where the restroom is.
Thanking someone warmly for their help.
Saying that you want to buy a new piece of clothing.
Telling someone it is a bit cold today and they should dress warmly.
A very common friendly greeting asking whether someone has eaten yet.
Telling someone it is fine and they should not worry about it.
Saying that you live nearby.
Politely asking someone to repeat what they said.
Saying that there are three people in your family.
Saying that you are really tired today.

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Describing a daily routine of getting up early and then going for a run.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 我早上一般七点起床，然后去跑步。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Suggesting going to a movie together if the other person is free at the weekend.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 周末你有空的话，我们去看电影吧。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Politely saying you are busy right now and will get back to the person later.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 不好意思，我现在有点忙，晚点回你。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Recommending the noodles at a restaurant and urging someone to try them.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 这家店的面条特别好吃，你一定要试试。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Saying the subway is too crowded, so you will take a taxi instead.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 地铁太挤了，我还是打车过去吧。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Noticing someone seems happy and asking whether something good happened.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 你今天看起来心情不错，有什么好事吗？

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Explaining that you slept badly last night and feel low on energy today.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 我昨天晚上睡得不好，今天没什么精神。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Asking a favor: please bring back a cup of milk tea for me.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 麻烦你帮我带一杯奶茶，谢谢。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Pointing out that it has started raining and asking if the person brought an umbrella.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 外面开始下雨了，你带伞了吗？

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Saying you plan to rest properly at home this weekend.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 这个周末我打算在家好好休息。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Greeting an old friend and asking how they have been lately.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 我们已经好久没见面了，最近怎么样？

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Saying the price is a bit high and asking for a discount.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 价钱有点贵，能不能便宜一点儿？

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Asking someone to sit down for a moment because you will be ready soon.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 你先坐一会儿，我马上就好。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Saying your phone battery is almost dead and asking for a charger.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 我的手机快没电了，你有充电器吗？

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Explaining that traffic is bad and you may arrive about ten minutes late.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 路上堵车了，我可能会迟到十分钟。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Telling someone to go home and rest early if they feel unwell.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 如果你不舒服，就早点回家休息。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Saying you have been learning to cook recently but are not very good yet.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 我最近在学做饭，做得还不太好。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Saying it is your first time here and the place feels quite comfortable.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 这个地方我第一次来，感觉挺舒服的。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Reassuring someone not to worry because you will handle the matter.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 你别担心，这件事交给我来处理。

Daily Conversation|Intermediate.meaning: Informing someone that today's meeting has been moved to three in the afternoon.
Daily Conversation|Intermediate.sentence: 今天的会议改到下午三点了。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: As technology develops, people's way of life keeps changing.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 随着科技的发展，人们的生活方式也在不断改变。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: Despite facing many difficulties, he still persisted and finished the whole project.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 尽管遇到了不少困难，他依然坚持完成了整个项目。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: Language is not only a tool for communication but also an important carrier of culture.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 语言不仅是交流的工具，也是文化的重要载体。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The city's night view looks especially charming under the lights.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 这座城市的夜景在灯光的映衬下显得格外迷人。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: He is used to carefully weighing all the possible outcomes before making a decision.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 他习惯在做决定之前，仔细权衡各种可能的结果。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: Only by truly understanding the other person's situation can you make a fair judgment.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 只有真正理解对方的处境，才能做出合理的判断。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The data in this research report comes from reliable sources and its conclusions are quite rigorous.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 这份研究报告的数据来源可靠，结论也相当严谨。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: A long-term lack of sleep seriously affects a person's attention and mood.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 长期缺乏睡眠会严重影响一个人的注意力和情绪。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: When he talked about the past, his tone was calm but his eyes were full of emotion.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 他讲述往事的时候，语气平静，眼神却充满感情。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: No matter what environment you are in, keeping the ability to think independently matters.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 无论身处何种环境，保持独立思考的能力都很重要。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: On a spring morning, the mist in the mountains slowly clears and sunlight spreads over the land.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 春天的清晨，山间的雾气慢慢散去，阳光洒满大地。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: He firmly believes that failure often teaches us more than success does.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 他坚持认为，失败往往比成功能教会我们更多东西。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The implementation of this policy has had a far-reaching effect on the local economy.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 这项政策的实施，对当地经济产生了深远的影响。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: Reading classic works broadens your horizons and deepens your thinking.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 阅读经典作品能够拓宽视野，也能提升思考的深度。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: Faced with a sudden change, he stayed unusually calm and rational.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 面对突如其来的变化，他表现得异常冷静和理智。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: True friendship stands the test of time and can also survive distance.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 真正的友谊经得起时间的考验，也承受得住距离。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: If we look at it from another angle, the problem may not be so serious.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 如果我们能换个角度思考，问题也许就没那么严重。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: He spent three whole years mastering this craft to perfection.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 他花了整整三年时间，才把这门手艺练得炉火纯青。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The rapid expansion of cities makes people miss quiet country life more and more.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 城市的快速扩张，让人们越来越怀念安静的乡村生活。

Read Aloud|Advanced.meaning: The teacher reminded us that learning knowledge matters, but being a good person matters even more.
Read Aloud|Advanced.sentence: 老师提醒我们，学习知识固然重要，做人更加关键。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: The weather is nice today, so let's go out for a walk.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 今天天气很好，我们出去走走吧。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: I get up at seven every morning and then have breakfast.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 我每天早上七点起床，然后吃早饭。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: This book is interesting and I really enjoy reading it.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 这本书很有意思，我很喜欢看。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: Please speak a little more slowly, I can't hear you clearly.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 请你慢一点说，我听不太清楚。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: My home is not far from school, about ten minutes on foot.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 我家离学校不远，走路十分钟。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: The food my mother cooked smells great, and I ate two bowls.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 妈妈做的饭很香，我吃了两碗。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: I would like a cup of hot tea, thank you.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 我想喝一杯热茶，谢谢你。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: On weekends I often play ball with my friends.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 周末我常常和朋友一起打球。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: He is my classmate and also a good friend of mine.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 他是我的同学，也是我的好朋友。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: It's raining outside, remember to take an umbrella.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 外面下雨了，你记得带伞。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: This apple is big and sweet, give it a try.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 这个苹果又大又甜，你尝一尝。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: I am learning Chinese and I find it a bit difficult.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 我在学中文，觉得有点难。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 请问，去火车站怎么走？

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: In the evening I like to listen to music and watch movies.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 晚上我喜欢听音乐，看电影。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: Sorry I'm late, the traffic was very heavy.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 对不起，我来晚了，路上很堵。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: My room is not big, but it is very clean.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 我的房间不大，但是很干净。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: What would you like to eat today? It's on me.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 你今天想吃什么？我请客。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: The puppy runs so fast that I can't catch up with it.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 小狗跑得很快，我追不上它。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: Thank you for your help, you are really kind.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 谢谢你的帮忙，你真好。

Read Aloud|Beginner.meaning: See you tomorrow, take care on your way.
Read Aloud|Beginner.sentence: 明天见，路上小心一点。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will go to the park for a picnic.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去公园野餐。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: Although work is busy, I still keep exercising regularly.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 虽然工作很忙，但是我还是坚持锻炼。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: He tidies up his room while listening to music.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 他一边听音乐，一边打扫自己的房间。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The service at this restaurant is good and the prices are reasonable.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 这家餐厅的服务态度好，价格也很合理。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: I have been living in this city for about five years now.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 我已经在这个城市住了差不多五年了。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: As long as you prepare seriously, the exam will be no problem.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 只要你认真准备，考试就一定没问题。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The subway is faster than the bus, but it is very crowded in the morning.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 地铁比公交车快，可是早上人特别多。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: I plan to visit my grandparents in the countryside this weekend.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 我打算周末去看望住在乡下的爷爷奶奶。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: His Chinese is improving fast because he practices every day.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 他的中文进步很快，因为他每天都练习。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: Please close the window, the wind outside is a bit strong.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 请把窗户关上，外面的风有点儿大。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: This problem is much more complicated than I originally thought.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 这个问题比我原来想的要复杂得多。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: We had better book tickets early so we don't end up without seats.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 我们最好提前订票，免得到时候没有座位。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: He speaks so softly that I can hardly hear him.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 他说话的声音很轻，我几乎听不见。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: I went to bed very late last night, so I am extremely sleepy today.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 昨天晚上我睡得很晚，今天特别困。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: No matter how hard it is, he never complains.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 无论多么辛苦，他从来都不抱怨。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: I think the most important part of travelling is relaxing your mind.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 我觉得旅行最重要的是放松心情。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The air is getting drier and drier, so remember to drink more water.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 空气变得越来越干燥，记得多喝水。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: The teacher explained it very clearly and all the students understood.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 老师讲得非常清楚，同学们都听懂了。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: My phone ran out of battery, so I couldn't reply to you in time.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 手机没电了，所以我没能及时回你消息。

Read Aloud|Intermediate.meaning: As soon as he walked in, he smelled the nice aroma from the kitchen.
Read Aloud|Intermediate.sentence: 他一进门就闻到了厨房里的香味。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: No matter what difficulties come up, you will keep going to the very end.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 无论遇到什么困难，我都会坚持到底。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: This experience made you rethink the direction of your life.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 这次经历让我重新思考自己的人生方向。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: The reason he succeeded is that he never gives up easily.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 他之所以成功，是因为他从不轻易放弃。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: As technology advances, the way people live is changing too.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 随着科技的发展，人们的生活方式也在改变。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: We should learn to look at things from another person's point of view.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 我们应该学会站在别人的角度考虑问题。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: This is easy to talk about but quite hard to actually do.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 这件事情说起来容易，做起来却相当困难。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: His knowledge of this industry goes far beyond what you imagined.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 他对这个行业的了解远远超过我的想象。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Had you prepared seriously back then, the outcome might have been completely different.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 如果当初我认真准备，结果可能完全不同。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: The report is not only detailed but also analysed in real depth.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 这份报告不仅内容详细，而且分析得很深入。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Before deciding, we have to weigh up all the possible consequences.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 在做决定之前，我们必须权衡各种可能的后果。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Language is more than a tool; it also carries a people's culture.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 语言不只是工具，它还承载着一个民族的文化。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Despite tough conditions, they still completed the research.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 尽管条件艰苦，他们还是完成了这项研究。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: You hope the other person will seriously consider the suggestion you just made.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 我希望你能认真考虑我刚才提出的那个建议。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Only through constant reflection can a person truly make progress.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 只有不断反思，一个人才能真正取得进步。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: He explained a complicated idea very clearly, which was impressive.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 他把复杂的道理讲得清清楚楚，令人印象深刻。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: This approach looks convenient on the surface but actually causes more trouble.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 这种做法表面上省事，实际上会带来更多麻烦。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: We have to admit that changing a habit has never been easy.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 我们必须承认，改变习惯从来都不是一件容易的事。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: His explanation was reasonable, yet it still did not convince everyone.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 他的解释虽然合理，却仍然没有说服所有的人。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: Sustained effort usually matters more than a burst of enthusiasm.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 长期的努力往往比一时的热情更加重要。

Speak Sentences|Advanced.meaning: When facing an unfamiliar environment, staying curious is very important.
Speak Sentences|Advanced.sentence: 面对陌生的环境，保持好奇心是非常重要的。

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: A friendly greeting used when meeting someone for the first time.
You introduce yourself and then ask the other person for their name.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 我叫小明，你叫什么名字？

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: The weather is nice, so you suggest going out for a walk.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 今天天气很好，我们出去走走吧。

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: A polite way to say you did not understand what the other person said.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 对不起，我听不懂你说的话。

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: You ask someone to speak more slowly so you can follow.
You say that you would like a cup of hot tea.
You ask the price of something and say it is too expensive.
A warm way to thank someone for helping you.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 谢谢你的帮助，我很感谢。

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: You explain that you are a student and you are learning Chinese.
A polite way to ask where the restroom is.
You describe your daily habit of getting up at seven in the morning.
You invite someone to go and have lunch together.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 我们一起去吃午饭好吗？

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: You describe your family: two older brothers and one younger sister.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 我有两个哥哥和一个妹妹。

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: You are tired today and plan to go to bed early.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 今天太累了，我要早点睡觉。

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: You explain that he is not home because he went to work.
You say you enjoy watching films and listening to music.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 我喜欢看电影，也喜欢听音乐。

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: You say a book is interesting and offer it to someone.
Speak Sentences|Beginner.sentence: 这本书很有意思，你要看吗？

Speak Sentences|Beginner.meaning: A friendly goodbye telling someone to take care on the way.
You politely say that you do not eat spicy food.
You ask the time and say that you have to leave.

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You plan to go hiking tomorrow as long as it does not rain.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去爬山。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You mention that you have worked at this company for over three years.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 我已经在这家公司工作了三年多。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: The job keeps you busy, yet you still find it interesting.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 虽然工作很忙，但是我觉得很有意思。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: A polite request asking someone to send you a document.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 麻烦你把这份文件发给我，好吗？

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You plan to visit a friend's home over the weekend.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 我打算周末去朋友家做客。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You apologize for arriving late because of traffic.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 刚才路上堵车，所以我来晚了。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: The dish tastes even better than you expected.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 这道菜的味道比我想象的还要好。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: He tidies up the room while listening to music at the same time.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 他一边听音乐，一边整理房间。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You ask someone to take a quick look at a sentence for you.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 你能不能帮我看一下这个句子？

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You believe that mastering a language takes a lot of practice.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 我觉得学好一门语言需要很多练习。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: Lately you keep forgetting to take your keys when you go out.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 最近我常常忘记带钥匙出门。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You suggest meeting at a coffee shop at three in the afternoon.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 我们下午三点在咖啡馆见面吧。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You apologize for getting someone's name wrong.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 对不起，我把你的名字记错了。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: The plane tickets for this weekend are already sold out.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 这个周末的机票已经卖完了。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: He always looks at you with a smile while he is talking.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 他说话的时候总是笑着看着你。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You have been especially interested in drawing since you were little.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 我从小就对画画特别感兴趣。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You ask someone to reserve a seat by the window for you.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 请你帮我留一个靠窗的座位。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: The more you practise speaking, the more confident you become.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 越练习说话，你就会越有信心。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: You have not yet decided whether to change jobs.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 我还没决定要不要换工作。

Speak Sentences|Intermediate.meaning: Yesterday's meeting lasted for roughly two hours.
Speak Sentences|Intermediate.sentence: 昨天的会议开了差不多两个小时。
